tutorials.text:
# Sonic Colours (Wii) Setup Guide

## Required Software

- [Archipelago 0.6.7](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest) or newer
- [Dolphin Emulator](https://dolphin-emu.org/download/) (64-bit)
- An unmodified, uncompressed Sonic Colours Wii Rev0 ISO: PAL `SNCP8P` or NTSC-U `SNCE8P`
- The [Sonic Colours `.apworld` file](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/releases)
- [Wiimms ISO Tools](https://wit.wiimm.de/): installed automatically when needed on Windows; install it separately on other platforms

Other regions and revisions are not supported. The installer verifies the original executable and resource archive before patching. NTSC-U uses the same verified files as PAL; a full NTSC-U Dolphin gameplay test is still pending.

The same player patch works with either supported region, including existing PAL-generated patches. The installer keeps the region of your original ISO; no region option or new seed is needed. Dolphin stores PAL and NTSC-U saves separately.
The installer remembers your original ISO and reuses it automatically. If the saved file is missing or invalid, it asks you to select it again. Command-line launches can provide a different path with `--original-iso`.

## Installing the APWorld

1. Install Archipelago and download `sonic_colours_wii.apworld`.
2. Double-click the `.apworld` file to install it.
3. Restart the Archipelago Launcher and check that the Sonic Colours (Wii) Client appears.
4. If Archipelago asks to install missing requirements, allow it. The client needs Dolphin Memory Engine to connect to Dolphin.

## Creating a YAML and Generating a Game

Create a Sonic Colours player YAML using the Archipelago Launcher's Options Creator and set your player name and options. Place the YAML in your Archipelago `Players` folder for local generation.

Generate the multiworld through the Generate Button in the Archipelago Launcher.
Host your game on `archipelago.gg` and create a room. When the port appears, download your patch file from the room page.

## How to Play

1. Make sure you have `Enable Cheats` enabled and `Memory Override` disabled in your Dolphin Settings. Please also check that no `Gecko Codes` or `AR Codes` are enabled.
2. Open your `.apsoniccolours` patch using the **Sonic Colours (Wii)** Client in the Archipelago Launcher.
3. When prompted, select your Dolphin executable and your original PAL or NTSC-U Rev0 ISO. The installer creates a separate patched ISO in the folder your patch file is located; your original ISO stays unchanged.
4. Wait for the patching and verification to finish. Dolphin will start the patched ISO automatically.
5. If the patch file was downloaded after the port was created, the client will connect automatically. If not, connect the client to your Archipelago room using its full address and port, your player name and, if required, the room password.
6. Connect **before starting New Game**, so the client can detect checks during the opening Acts. Choose a free save slot when the game prompts you to after Tropical Resort Act 2.
7. Wait for the client to connect to Dolphin and enjoy playing! Keep using the same patch, patched ISO and save for the seed. 

No manual Gecko codes or Riivolution setup is required. Keep the generated ISO and its accompanying `.iso.sonic.json` file; the generated ISO contains game data and should not be redistributed.

# Luma's Archipelago Integrations

A repository for Archipelago integrations of multiple of my favourite childhood games.

## Marbles! Balance Challenge

An Archipelago implementation for Marbles! Balance Challenge *(European / PAL Version)*. The current release does **NOT YET** include Marble Saga Kororinpa *(American / NTSC-U Version)*!

Read first: [Setup Guide](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/blob/Marbles!-Balance-Challenge-AP/worlds/marbles_balance_challenge/docs/setup_en.md)

Then skim through the [Game Documentation](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/blob/Marbles!-Balance-Challenge-AP/worlds/marbles_balance_challenge/docs/en_Marbles!%20Balance%20Challenge.md) for goals, locations, items, options, and notes about the current release.

Latest release: [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/releases)

Source code: [worlds/marbles_balance_challenge](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/tree/Marbles!-Balance-Challenge-AP/worlds/marbles_balance_challenge)

## Create

An Archipelago implementation for Create *(Wii, European / PAL Version, `SECP69`)*, using an external Dolphin client. Currently, only Save Slot 3 is supported.

Read first: [Setup Guide](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/blob/Create-AP/worlds/create/docs/setup_en.md)

Then skim through the [Game Documentation](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/blob/Create-AP/worlds/create/docs/en_Create.md) for goals, locations, items, options, and notes about the current release.

Latest release: [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/releases)

Source code: [worlds/create](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/tree/Create-AP/worlds/create)

## Carnival Games MiniGolf

An Archipelago implementation for Carnival Games MiniGolf *(Wii, European / PAL Version, `RG9P54`)*, using an external Dolphin client.

Read first: [Setup Guide](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/blob/Carnival-Games-MiniGolf-AP/worlds/carnival_games_minigolf/docs/setup_en.md)

Then skim through the [Game Documentation](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/blob/Carnival-Games-MiniGolf-AP/worlds/carnival_games_minigolf/docs/en_Carnival%20Games%20MiniGolf.md) for goals, locations, items, options, and notes about the current release.

Latest release: [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/releases)

Source code: [worlds/carnival_games_minigolf](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/tree/Carnival-Games-MiniGolf-AP/worlds/carnival_games_minigolf)

## Sonic Colours (Wii)

An Archipelago implementation for Sonic Colours *(Wii, PAL and NTSC-U Versions supported)*, using Dolphin and a locally patched ISO.

Read first: [Setup Guide](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/blob/Sonic-Colours-Wii-AP/worlds/sonic_colours/docs/setup.md)

Then skim through the [Game Documentation](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/blob/Sonic-Colours-Wii-AP/worlds/sonic_colours/docs/sonic_colours.md) for goals, locations, items, options, and verification limits.

Latest releases: [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/releases)

Source code: [worlds/sonic_colours](https://github.com/mariokirby1703/Lumas-Archipelago/tree/Sonic-Colours-Wii-AP/worlds/sonic_colours)

notes.text:
# Sonic Colours (Wii) AP v0.2.2
## Fixes and improvements
- Improved client responsiveness, item synchronization and check delivery
- Improved Dolphin reconnection after restarting the game
- Fixed checks and item delivery stopping after interrupted saving
- Improved DeathLink detection around pauses and rapid deaths
- **Dead Weight Trap** now only lasts 10 seconds
- Reworked **Score Reset Trap** to reset points through the native game thread
- Fixed new Red Ring pickups being lost when previously collected rings are restored after dying
- Added Sliding to Tropical Resort Act 4 S-rank requirement and raised remaining Aquarium Park Act 1 breathing requirements to Level 2
- Prevented completing all Game Land stages from automatically unlocking **Super Sonic**
- Moved uncertain filler-delivery messages into diagnostics for less confusion for players
- Fixed continuous spring bouncing while using the 60 FPS patch
- Updated PopTracker Logic
## Known issues
- **60 FPS can cause physics issues**, including falling out of loops or frenzy jumping way too high
